day_shape: 80 items: Israel-Lebanon agreement aftermath dominates with IDF Golani officer Cpt. David Hazutt (21) killed in south Lebanon, Khamenei successor issues lengthy Judiciary Week message on prosecuting 1404-1405 'war crimes', Araghchi visits Baghdad, two Holon/Tel Aviv car blasts reported, no UK/OFAC items.

threads.label: Israel-Lebanon agreement and southern Lebanon clashes
threads.summary: IDF Chief Eyal Zamir called Friday's Israel-Lebanon agreement 'historic', crediting military achievements, while Cpt. David Hazutt (21) of Golani's 12th Battalion was killed overnight in a clash with a Hezbollah operative. Jerusalem Post reported Hezbollah supporters rioted in Beirut over the weekend and described a new southern Lebanon security zone resembling the 1980s-90s model.

threads.label: Iranian response to Lebanon agreement
threads.summary: Iran's foreign ministry spokesman Baghaei demanded an Israeli withdrawal timetable from Lebanon citing the Islamabad understanding, and Speaker Qalibaf told Lebanese counterpart Nabih Berri Iran was 'seriously pursuing' an end to the war. Khamenei adviser Velayati posted that Hezbollah is 'the true guardian of Lebanon's independence', while Defa Press published commentary on the Islamabad accord.

threads.label: Khamenei successor's Judiciary Week message
threads.summary: A message from Ayatollah Sayyed Mojtaba Khamenei marking Judiciary Week and the anniversary of Beheshti's killing called pursuit of Iranian victims' rights from the '1404 and 1405' international crimes among the country's most important judicial priorities. The message said US and Israeli leaders' 'confessions' to the crimes had paved the way for prosecutions over Minab and Lamerd casualties in domestic and international courts.

threads.label: Funeral logistics for 'martyred leader'
threads.summary: Regime channels detailed planning for the funeral of the 'martyred leader', including Tehran traffic plans from 13 Tir, bus pre-sales 12-20 Tir to Tehran/Qom/Mashhad, a pilgrim accommodation bot, and a heritage ministry plan to register the ceremony as national heritage. Defa Press said the burial location had not yet been finalised.

threads.label: Araghchi visit to Baghdad and Iraq arrests
threads.summary: Iranian FM Abbas Araghchi travelled to Baghdad, meeting Iraqi PM Ali Falih al-Zaidi and President Nazar Amidi, and visiting the site near Baghdad airport where Soleimani and Abu Mahdi al-Muhandis were killed. Iran International reported Iraqi security forces arrested dozens of officials, including figures tied to Iran-aligned Shia parties, in a corruption case involving alleged smuggling of Iranian oil.

threads.label: Gaza strikes and Hamas commanders eliminated
threads.summary: The IDF announced the killing of Mansour Sami Mahmoud Shahtout, commander of Hamas's Naval Police in the central camps, alongside two other operatives in a Friday strike. Separate strikes killed Nukhba cell commander Abd al-Rahman Maher Abd al-Karim Ziyada, an October 7 infiltrator, and Khan Younis tunnel unit head Kamal Mohammad Hamdan Najjar.

threads.label: Gulf strikes and US-Israel Iran coordination
threads.summary: Bahrain condemned continued Iranian attacks as a 'dangerous escalation' and called on the UN to hold Tehran accountable, while the Jerusalem Post reported last Thursday's Zamir-Cooper meeting focused mainly on Iran. A Post source said CENTCOM weekend strikes hit newly built Iranian sites or locations not previously targeted; USS George H.W. Bush conducted flight operations in the Arabian Sea.

events.title: An IDF officer was killed in a clash with a Hezbollah gunman in southern Lebanon overnight, the military announces. The slain soldier is named as Cpt. David Hazutt, 21, a platoon commander in the Golani Brigade's 12th Battalion, from Ashkelon. According to an IDF probe of the incident, at around 2 a.m., Golani soldiers encountered a Hezbollah operative as they entered a structure in the village of Deir Siryan. During the clash, Hazutt was killed and another soldier was lightly hurt. The IDF says the wounded soldier was taken to a hospital and his family was notified. Troops have launched searches for the operative, and struck Hezbollah sites in the area, the military adds.
